source: maintenance at 60 planes, 8 days, 6 airports (random, seed 10). The office proposes the greedy schedule (most planes first): 7 days, none redundant. The optimum, 6 days, is unique and shares at most one crew-day with it. Generated by the set-cover ladder search. Too large for the reference check: pddlpy gbfs needs ~400 s, astar ~600 s, ucs more than 600 s. check validates optimal.plan at the optimum instead; the generator's exhaustive search proves no 5-day schedule exists.
